breakdown.title: Score breakdown
breakdown.aforce_bonus_hint_zero: Log an AForce stick or RTD

coach.morning_action: Drink {{oz}} oz now. Recheck in 25 minutes. You are starting in deficit.
coach.morning_explanation: Overnight loss: {{oz}} oz. Reset your baseline before training.
coach.peak_action: Score {{score}}. Peak. Drink 8 oz before next session. Hold the line.
coach.peak_explanation: Maintain pace. Stick during exertion if heat or output rises.
coach.balanced_action: Score {{score}}. Balanced. Drink 12 oz now. Recheck in 45 minutes.
coach.balanced_explanation: You are on pace. Stay ahead of the next deficit window.
coach.recovering_action: Score {{score}}. Recovering. Take 1 AForce stick with 16 oz now. Recheck in 20 minutes.
coach.recovering_explanation: You are trending down. Reverse the curve before it accelerates.
coach.depleted_action: Score {{score}}. Depleted. Drink 20 oz and take 2 sticks now. Recheck in 10 minutes.
coach.depleted_explanation: Critical deficit. Electrolytes required. Performance is compromised.
coach.social_drink_water_action: Drink 12 oz of water now. Then pace your next drink for 30 minutes.
coach.social_drink_water_explanation: Hydration after a drink protects tomorrow. One glass now resets the curve.
coach.social_take_rtd_action: Take 1 AForce RTD now. Drink 16 oz water before the next round.
coach.social_take_rtd_explanation: Hangover risk is rising ({{score}}/100). Electrolytes now make morning easier.
coach.social_slow_intake_action: Sip water between drinks. You're at {{count}} so far — pace from here.
coach.social_slow_intake_explanation: Spacing drinks to 30+ minutes keeps the score stable and the morning clean.
coach.social_recovery_action: Drink 20 oz of water and take 1 AForce RTD before sleep.
coach.social_recovery_explanation: Recovery window is open. Two units of fluid + electrolytes now is the difference.
coach.social_stop_explanation: You are in a high-impairment window. Switch to water and start the recovery protocol.
coach.social_do_not_drive_action: Do not drive. Use a rideshare or call a friend.
coach.social_do_not_drive_explanation: Reaction time and judgment are significantly reduced. A ride is the safer next move.

social.title: SOCIAL MODE
social.intro_body: Social Mode keeps your hydration on track in real time. Pick what you're drinking and we'll handle the rest — pacing, water reminders, and a recovery plan.
social.recovery_body: You stopped drinking recently. The next 8 hours decide how you'll feel in the morning.
social.hydration_prompt: Did you drink water or an AForce RTD after that last one?
social.recovery_step_water: Drink 20 oz of water before bed.
social.safety_use_rideshare: Plan a ride before your next drink.
social.safety_stop_drinking: Stop adding alcohol. Switch to water.
social.safety_transportation: Use a rideshare, taxi, or call a friend.
social.safety_moderate_body: Coordination and judgment are reduced. Arrange a ride before you need one.
social.safety_high_body: Reaction time is significantly impaired. Do not drive any vehicle.
social.safety_critical_body: You are at a high-risk impairment level. Stop alcohol intake and arrange safe transport now.
social.not_legal_medical: Not a legal or medical determination.

voice.drink_now: Take 1 AForce unit now. Recheck in {{recheck}} minutes.
voice.drink_water_now: Drink {{oz}} oz of water now. Recheck in {{recheck}} minutes.
voice.balanced: Holding steady. Stay on the protocol.
